reason: The free first visit makes it easy to try, and a clean, calm place where I can sit with a real coffee on a Saturday sounds a lot nicer than CoCo's. I work full time, so it would be a Saturday thing, and I'd see after the free visit whether it's actually clean and not loud.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? I work all week, so I'd only come on weekends, and $15 a kid plus a sibling adds up fast for a Saturday outing. Unlimited at $45 doesn't pay off for me when I can only come on weekends.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price under $12, or seeing in person on the free visit that it's clean, not crowded, and the cleaning log is real.
